column_description: BIGSERIAL. Unique identifier for the water and waste record. PK.
TEXT. Reference to the equipment. FK to Equipment.EQUIP_CODE.
REAL. Water pressure in kPa. Example: 66.4.
TEXT. Water temperature in Celsius. **NULL means no water temperature data recorded.**. Example: 58.4 °C.
REAL. Water flow in liters per minute. Example: 28.6.
